mapper.select:
select id, sku_id, sku_no, source_id, source_code, source_type, warehouse_id, qty, status, from_warehouse_area, from_warehouse_location, to_warehouse_area, to_warehouse_location, suggest_qty, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_name, update_time from warehouse_location_replenish where is_deleted = false
and ${params.sqlMap.default}
select status as tabFlag, count(1) as count from warehouse_location_replenish where is_deleted = false group by status

select * from ( SELECT wlsi.warehouse_id, wlsi.sku_id, wlsi.warehouse_location, wlsi.safety_qty, wlsi.max_qty, wlsi.sku_no, it.usable_qty, wa.areaCode AS warehouseArea, CASE WHEN wlsi.max_qty >0 THEN wlsi.max_qty - it.usable_qty ELSE wlsi.safety_qty - it.usable_qty END as qty FROM warehouse_location_safety_inventory AS wlsi LEFT JOIN ( SELECT it.warehouse_id, it.sku_id, it.warehouse_location, SUM ( CASE WHEN it.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END ) AS usable_qty FROM inventory it WHERE it.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY it.warehouse_id, it.sku_id, it.warehouse_location ) it ON wlsi.warehouse_id = it.warehouse_id AND wlsi.warehouse_location = it.warehouse_location AND wlsi.sku_id = it.sku_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT wa.warehouse_id, wa.code AS areaCode, wl.code AS location_code FROM warehouse_location wa LEFT JOIN warehouse_location wl ON wl.parent_id = wa.ID AND wl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wa.TYPE = 'area' AND wa.is_deleted = FALSE ) wa ON wlsi.warehouse_id = wa.warehouse_id AND wlsi.warehouse_location = wa.location_code WHERE wlsi.is_deleted = FALSE AND wlsi.safety_qty > 0 AND wlsi.safety_qty > it.usable_qty ) as re where re.qty > 0 ORDER BY sku_id
